incidents.title: Compromise of ssh-srv via Brute Force, Privilege Escalation, and Data Exfiltration

kill_chain.description: External port scanning against ssh-srv from 203.0.113.213.
Brute-force attack from external IP 203.0.113.213 resulting in successful unauthorized login for deploy user.
Compromised deploy user executed sudo to root to escalate privileges.
Large outbound data transfer from ssh-srv to external IP 198.51.100.200.

incidents.rationale: Linked scan, brute force, successful login, root shell (sudo), and outbound transfer into ONE incident based on shared source IP 203.0.113.213, target host ssh-srv, and strict chronological plausibility.
